final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (CC8.1, owned by security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) gives the wording. A live check of harborlight/app at 2026-11-18T03:46:07Z found the same setting: branch main is protected, needs 2 approving reviews, and the rule covers administrators. Both sources cover only the harborlight/app repository. Nothing was found about any other repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:49b28130-11c2-49e0-b24e-428b68aac: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:4a5b00a9-6523-4a99-9e2d-3606b1a7c: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:beb206cd-f442-4140-89a6-71aede86e: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:362acbb6-2672-4e11-a603-ca484e9f6: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:a0281ce3-8952-46fd-8b46-7acb5c062: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:9f437804-9edf-4fbf-95d4-6392d29: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-18 03:46 UTC.
